verdict.rationale: Unity Catalog docs say it automatically tracks lineage as data and AI assets are used and logs activity for auditing. Delta table history can also be used to audit operations. However, the evidence never states that lineage reaches column granularity or details who-ran-what audit fields; the mention of columns and lineage only describes what Genie Code works with. Missing for 10: explicit column-level lineage documentation, detail on audit log content and delivery (user identity, query text, system tables), independent or hands-on corroboration.
